en.summary: This commit fixes zero-gated A-operand propagation in the mesh by using bubble-style valid pipelining instead of an enable-stalled ShiftRegister.
why_it_counts: It changes Mesh datapath logic on the A input path of the systolic array.
The patch replaces ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z) with pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1) in the zero-gated A chain.
Using hold-style enable gating on zero operands can replay stale A values instead of injecting bubbles for zeros.
evidence: The commit touches only src/main/scala/gemmini/Mesh.scala and specifically the zero-gated A-path loop.
The new code routes A operands through the same pipe helper style already used for other valid-gated mesh links.
The surrounding code computes in_a_zero and forwards zero-gating state tile by tile, so the change directly affects how zero operands move through the array.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Zero gating in a systolic or lane-based datapath should insert bubbles for zero operands so downstream stages do not recompute on stale nonzero data. If the implementation instead uses an enable-stalled register chain, a zero input can freeze the previous nonzero operand in place and replay it on later cycles. That changes arithmetic behavior, not just power behavior, because the array effectively reuses the wrong A operand when a zero should have suppressed work.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: zero-operand bubble insertion on a pipelined mesh input
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A zero-valued A operand arrives while prior nonzero A data is still resident in the propagation pipeline.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace bubble-style valid propagation with hold-last-value gating on the zero-gated A path.
portability_notes: Map this to any operand path where zeros are supposed to suppress work while data continues to advance through a pipelined fabric.
The essence of the bug is stale operand replay under zero gating, not the specific Chisel primitive used in Gemmini.
If another DUT has an explicit valid signal, inject the bug by stalling registers on zero rather than letting an invalid bubble move forward.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the zero-gated operand pipeline for the multiplicand or A-like input in the compute fabric.
Change the zero case from bubble or valid-based propagation to a register-enable hold that preserves the previous operand.
Keep zero detection itself intact so the fault comes only from wrong propagation semantics.
Run a workload with intermittent zero A operands following nonzero operands and check for spurious products or partial sums.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Mesh zero-gated A-path chaining across rows
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z) with pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1) for zero-gated A propagation.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the zero-gated A-path loop, change ina := pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1) back to ina := ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Zero-valued A operands fail to insert bubbles cleanly and instead replay earlier nonzero A data, producing spurious multiplies or stale partial sums.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is isolated to the A-path zero-gating propagation semantics.
The surrounding mesh code already uses the pipe helper for valid-driven propagation, which reinforces that bubble semantics were intended.
The original expression used an enabled ShiftRegister, a common way to accidentally hold stale data under zero gating.
notes: This bug is easiest to see in traces with sparse zeros interleaved with nonzero operands.
It is a correctness bug, not merely a power-optimization issue, because stale arithmetic inputs are replayed.

zh.summary: 该提交通过把 A 操作数路径从 enable 停滞式 ShiftRegister 改为气泡式 valid 流水，修复了 mesh 中零门控传播错误。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是 systolic array A 输入路径上的 Mesh 数据通路逻辑。
补丁把零门控 A 链路中的 ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z) 替换成了 pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1)。
对零操作数使用 hold 风格的 enable 门控会重放陈旧的 A 值，而不是为零注入气泡。
evidence: 该提交只修改了 src/main/scala/gemmini/Mesh.scala，而且集中在零门控的 A-path 循环上。
新代码把 A 操作数改为通过与其他 valid 驱动 mesh 链路一致的 pipe helper 传播。
周围代码会逐 tile 计算 in_a_zero 并传递零门控状态，因此这个修改直接影响零操作数在阵列中的传播方式。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 systolic array 或 lane 化数据通路中，零门控应当为零操作数注入气泡，这样下游阶段就不会在陈旧的非零数据上重复计算。如果实现错误地改用 enable 停滞式寄存器链，那么零输入会把之前的非零操作数冻结在原地，并在后续周期中被重放。这样改变的不是功耗行为，而是真正的算术行为，因为阵列会在本应抑制计算时重复使用错误的 A 操作数。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 流水化 mesh 输入上的零操作数气泡插入
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个值为零的 A 操作数到来时，传播流水中仍然残留着先前的非零 A 数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把气泡式 valid 传播改成在零门控 A 路径上保持上一个值的 hold 风格门控。
portability_notes: 把它映射到任何本应在零操作数到来时抑制工作、但数据仍需穿过流水结构前进的操作数路径。
这个 bug 的本质是在零门控下重放陈旧操作数，而不是 Gemmini 使用了哪一种具体 Chisel 原语。
如果其他 DUT 显式带 valid 信号，就通过在零时 stall 寄存器而不是让 invalid bubble 前推来注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位计算阵列中 multiplicand 或 A 类输入的零门控流水路径。
把零情形下的气泡/valid 传播改成寄存器使能保持，从而保留上一个操作数。
保持零检测本身不变，使故障只来自错误的传播语义。
运行一个含有间歇性零 A 操作数、且前面紧跟非零操作数的工作负载，检查是否出现多余乘法或陈旧部分和。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Mesh 中按行传播的零门控 A 路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把零门控 A 传播从 ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z) 改成了 pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1)。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在零门控 A-path 循环里，把 ina := pipe(!z, a, tile_latency+1) 改回 ina := ShiftRegister(a, tile_latency+1, !z)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 值为零的 A 操作数无法正确注入气泡，反而会重放之前的非零 A 数据，产生额外乘法或陈旧部分和。
evidence_for_injection: 修复完全局限于 A-path 的零门控传播语义。
周围 mesh 代码已经使用 pipe helper 处理 valid 驱动传播，这进一步说明期望语义是气泡传播。
原始表达式使用了带 enable 的 ShiftRegister，这正是零门控下意外保留陈旧数据的常见来源。
notes: 这个 bug 在稀疏零值与非零操作数交错出现的轨迹上最容易观察到。
它是正确性错误，而不仅仅是功耗优化问题，因为会重放陈旧的算术输入。
